name: What are common challenges when implementing AEO for an optometry practice?

mainEntity.name: What are common challenges when implementing AEO for an optometry practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges in implementing AEO for an optometry practice include identifying the most frequently asked patient questions, crafting concise yet comprehensive answers, and effectively structuring content with appropriate schema markup. Keeping up with evolving search engine algorithms and understanding the nuances of how AI answer engines extract information can also be complex. Additionally, ensuring factual accuracy across all optimized content, particularly for medical information, requires careful attention and ongoing review.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges include identifying common patient questions, crafting concise answers, structuring content with schema, adapting to algorithm changes, and ensuring medical accuracy.
